note: Empirically calibrated using SAHI-wrapped YOLOv8n head detector (HuggingFace AmineSam/irail-crowd-counting-yolov8n). beta has near-zero correlation with kappa (R2=-0.04, confirmed). GT density (rho) is the dominant predictor (R2=0.62, corr=0.79). UCF-QNRF used standard YOLOv8 inference at imgsz=1280; ShanghaiTech used SAHI slicing (512x512, overlap=0.25).
source: SAHI + YOLOv8n head detection on ShanghaiTech A+B (SAHI) + UCF-QNRF (standard, imgsz=1280)
comparison_note: Previous YOLO person (COCO) had R2=0.6716 with alpha0=10.0, gamma=0.674. SAHI head gives R2=0.6152 with alpha0=8.244, gamma=1.133. The SAHI head model trades slightly lower R2 for much better detection rates on ShanghaiTech (83.8% vs ~60%) and physically correct head-based occlusion measurement.
